description.value: Artisans Attic and Fudgery Gift Shoppe is a charming stop in Hope, BC, offering homemade fudge, premium gelato, and a wide range of handcrafted gifts, souvenirs, clothing, and wellness products. The shop leans into Hope's Rambo tourism identity with a dedicated Rambo Souvenirs section alongside local artisan goods. For a touring cyclist passing through the Fraser Valley, it offers a sweet treat and browsable gift selection in a walkable downtown location.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: wall_loops (10 spaces) at 64m; rack at 93m. Total: 10 spaces.

raw_osm.description: Homemade fudge and premium gelato, quality handcrafts & other fine gifts.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a real, operating Shopify storefront for a gift shop and fudgery in Hope, BC (postal code V0X 1L0, consistent with OSM). The website name is 'Artisans Attic and Fudgery Gift Shoppe', slightly longer than the OSM name. The website content is dominated by navigation menus and currency selectors with almost no substantive prose, so no amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) can be confirmed. The 'Rambo Souvenirs' category in the nav confirms this is in Hope, BC, which is well-known for First Blood film tourism.
concerns: Website name ('Artisans Attic and Fudgery Gift Shoppe') is slightly longer than OSM name ('Artisans Attic and Fudgery') — minor discrepancy, OSM name retained per rules.
Website content is almost entirely Shopify navigation boilerplate; no substantive prose pages were captured, making amenity verification impossible.
